notes: Standard (non-Black-Friday) statics from 5 user references (2026-10-27), focused on Disney/theme-park walking, nurses and plus-size women. Standard offer stack (40% OFF, free shipping, 30-day money-back guarantee) as small lines; S45_03 has no offer. Dropped from refs: 'fall prevention', 'restores balance', 'pain-free', 'doctor recommended', 'science-backed', Google ratings, 'while stock lasts'. Disney appears only as words (no castles, characters or logos); the Disney ref's quote became a question so no testimonial is invented. S45_07-10 added from the user's stacked-shoe reference: 'designed for' Disney, plus-size, travel, nurses.
